question: Should US bombers keep flying from Fairford, yes or no?

lines.text: Update: five men are now being held on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act near RAF Fairford.
lines.note: AP via PBS, Army Times, CNN, 27 Sep

lines.text: Counter Terrorism Policing is now leading the investigation.
It started at a quarter to one this morning, with a call about three suspicious vehicles heading for the base.
About 85 homes in Whelford were evacuated.
Donald Trump says the men were looking to do big damage.
And that working with the British worked out great.

scene.quote: working with the British worked out great

lines.text: The Times and ITV report police are looking at a possible Iran link. Police have not given a motive.
lines.note: The Times, ITV News; AP (no motive given)

lines.text: Police say: we are in the early stages of an investigation.
lines.note: DAC Vicki Evans, Counter Terrorism Policing

scene.quote: we are in the early stages of an investigation

lines.text: So, should US bombers keep flying from Fairford, yes or no?
